label: What is its own being lacks no perfection of being, being in act in it formally or eminently
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: whatever is its own being lacks no perfection of being: each is in act in it in the shared frame's InAct (IN_ACT_4, mode of possession left open, so formally, virtually or eminently). It is the HAVING_EVERY_PERFECTION_1 side of DISAMB dc9c0a1b: it does not say that the bearer has each perfection as a real determination (Has, d164b1ff). ST I q.4 a.2 ad 3 states it ('nulla de perfectionibus essendi potest deesse ei quod est ipsum esse subsistens'). R-act2 makes at most this 'not lacking' a meaning postulate of subsistent esse, not real having. Open.
